We're here to make energy simpler, fairer, and better value for Australians. Our goal is to challenge the traditional energy model with transparent pricing, flexible plans, and genuine local service.

What sets us apart:

- Fair and transparent pricing. We keep our plans easy to understand, with no confusing discounts or inflated rates.

- Award-winning customer service. We've been recognised by ProductReview.com.au for three years running for our commitment to great customer experiences.

- Local support. Our Australian-based team in Richmond, Victoria, is here to help with friendly, knowledgeable service.

- Flexibility and freedom. No lock-in contracts or exit fees - you stay because you want to.

Give us a go - and even better, please tell us what you think.

offerDetails.retailerDescription:
Lumo Energy is an Australian energy retailer owned by Snowy Hydro, serving almost 550,000 customers across Victoria, New South Wales, South Australia and Queensland. It commenced retailing electricity in February 2004 under the name Victoria Electricity, South Australia Electricity, Queensland Electricity and New South Wales Electricity, coming together under one name and launching Lumo Energy in 2010.

As one of Australia?s fastest growing energy retailers, Lumo Energy?s vision is to provide easy-to-use energy solutions, while delivering them in a unique and customer friendly fashion. Lumo Energy values community highly, partnering with organisations to support grassroots initiatives and provide meaningful engagement with the public, beyond traditional expectations of an energy retailer. Currently, Lumo Energy supports The Salvation Army, Netball Victoria and the Western Bulldogs.

offerDetails.retailerDescription:
Momentum Energy is a 100% Australian-owned and operated, energy retailer. We pride ourselves on innovation and outstanding customer service.
We offer competitive rates to both residential and business customers along with a range of innovative energy products and services. We also retail natural gas to Victorian customers.
Momentum Energy is part of Hydro Tasmania, Australia's leading clean energy business. Hydro Tasmania is the largest generator of renewable energy in Australia ? generating hydro and wind power. Hydro Tasmania is also the nation?s largest water manager. It?s owned by the State of Tasmania and has been at the forefront of clean energy innovation for more than 100 years.
In addition to selling the electricity it produces through Momentum Energy, Hydro Tasmania shares its expertise via specialist power and water consulting firm Entura. Being part of the Hydro Tasmania group gives Momentum the confidence, stability, competitive pricing and asset base of big companies. Our commitment to customers and excellent service matches the superior performance associated with smaller providers.

We sell electricity and natural gas to millions of homes and businesses across Australia. We also offer internet services and help customers with solar and electric vehicle solutions, while investing in renewable sources such as wind and solar to help progress our cleaner energy ambitions.

Our great-value energy plans for both residential and business customers come with flexible billing and payment options, no lock-in contracts and a range of rewards designed to give you more.

And with our Origin app, you can pay bills on the go, set up a payment plan and access your rewards all in one convenient place. If you have a smart meter, you can also track your electricity use and costs - a handy tool to support energy saving goals.

Check us out at originenergy.com.au

contract.offer_arr_on_expiry: We'll give you notice before your contract ends. At the end of the contract term, we will continue to sell you energy and the terms and conditions of the Standard Retail Contract will apply, unless you tell us otherwise.
contract.offer_eligibility_clause: Offer only available when signing up through One Big Switch and to customers who opt to receive e-billing/correspondence via email on sign up (but can cancel these at any time and still receive the offer).
contract.offer_var_of_prices: We may vary the Charges (including their amount, nature and structure) by notice to you at any time. The notice will be at least 5 business days prior to the effective date of the variation.
contract.terms_and_conditions: Not available in all areas or property types. Residential customers only. See www.originenergy.com.au/2889/Terms-and-conditions for more.

fees.fee_description: A $51.95 (GST Incl) fee may apply when your property is disconnected (including when you move). This fee is passed through from your distributor and may vary. Please visit your distributor's website to find out the current fee.
fees.offer_add_info: You must pay us any charges your distributor imposes on us in relation to services performed by your distributor (or anyone else) at your supply address. For details on additional charges that may apply see www.originenergy.com.au/2402/Additional-charges

fees.fee_description: A $51.19 (GST Incl) fee may apply when your property is reconnected (including when you move). This fee is passed through from your distributor and may vary. Please visit your distributor's website to find out the current fee.

offerDetails.additionalFeeInformation: You must pay us any charges your distributor imposes on us in relation to services performed by your distributor (or anyone else) at your supply address. For details on additional charges that may apply see www.originenergy.com.au/2402/Additional-charges

We sell electricity and natural gas to millions of homes and businesses across Australia. We also offer internet services and help customers with solar and electric vehicle solutions, while investing in renewable sources such as wind and solar to help progress our cleaner energy ambitions.

Our great-value energy plans for both residential and business customers come with flexible billing and payment options, no lock-in contracts and a range of rewards designed to give you more.

And with our Origin app, you can pay bills on the go, set up a payment plan and access your rewards all in one convenient place. If you have a smart meter, you can also track your electricity use and costs - a handy tool to support energy saving goals.

Check us out at originenergy.com.au

offerDetails.retailerDescription:
At Origin, we are on a mission to show up for our customers, our communities and the planet - usefully.

We sell electricity and natural gas to millions of homes and businesses across Australia. We also offer internet services and help customers with solar and electric vehicle solutions, while investing in renewable sources such as wind and solar to help progress our cleaner energy ambitions.

Our great-value energy plans for both residential and business customers come with flexible billing and payment options, no lock-in contracts and a range of rewards designed to give you more.

And with our Origin app, you can pay bills on the go, set up a payment plan and access your rewards all in one convenient place. If you have a smart meter, you can also track your electricity use and costs - a handy tool to support energy saving goals.

Check us out at originenergy.com.au
